Eye-level camera, frontal composition, human scale, calm warm daytime. Elegant visual-novel background with fine brown linework, subtle painted shadows, restrained cream, warm oak, sage, dusty pink palette. Composition is important for compositing a character afterwards: landscape 1536x1024. A beige upholstered EMPTY client chair is centered at x=768. Its top at y=470, seat behind the desk. Big tall soft sunlit window, sheer curtains and a leafy plant on the left. A minimal arch niche in the central wall. A small round clock on the right wall. Quiet lived-in details, fresh branch in vase, tasteful framed abstract drawing. NO people, NO characters anywhere. The technician's WARM IVORY desk stretches across the ENTIRE foreground, back horizontal edge precisely at y=690 (about 67 percent down) and surface filling to the bottom edge. Desk surface CLEAN and uncluttered in its center; there is a small cream hand rest near the center, a closed matte-black nail gel jar and slender brush on a tray toward left edge, a simple warm-white curing lamp toward right edge. No text, letters, logos, watermark, game UI, speech bubbles, floating buttons. Illustration edge to edge, no frame. Highly polished actual game background, cozy and premium, soft afternoon sunlight.

finalStyleEdit.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit the reference environment into a genuinely DRAWN 2D VISUAL NOVEL GAME BACKGROUND. Convert the whole image to illustrated clean brown ink contours around every object and flat restrained pastel color fills with simple 2-tone cel-shading, matching classic hand-drawn Japanese visual novel backgrounds. Clearly visible line art, slight watercolor pigment on paper, beautiful mature slice-of-life anime interior.
